_comment: Expectations manifest for guard fixture tests. The test harness reads this file, creates a temp project dir with the specified markers, sets env vars per 'harness', pipes the fixture JSON to the guard script, and asserts the 'expect' outcome. Marker state is encoded here — NOT as real files in the repo.

cc-commit-gate-open-controller.json.description: CC: git commit + gate-open + no agent_id (controller) → B1 hard block
cc-commit-gate-open-controller.json.notes: B1 is context-agnostic; controller vs subagent does not matter here, but this case uses controller to exercise the most common real scenario.

cc-commit-gate-open-subagent.json.description: CC: git commit + gate-open + agent_id present (subagent) → B1 hard block
cc-commit-gate-open-subagent.json.notes: B1 fires regardless of agent_id. Subagents are not exempt from the commit block.

cc-commit-active-no-gate-controller.json.description: CC: git commit + active + NO gate-open + controller → allow + N2 nudge
cc-commit-active-no-gate-controller.json.notes: Controller running git commit during an active session should be nudged to use the repo git skill via a subagent instead.

cc-commit-active-no-gate-subagent.json.description: CC: git commit + active + NO gate-open + subagent → allow, NO nudge
cc-commit-active-no-gate-subagent.json.notes: Subagents are where git work belongs. No nudge emitted — they should run the command.

cc-npm-test-active-controller.json.description: CC: npm test + active + controller → allow + N1 nudge
cc-npm-test-active-controller.json.notes: Controller running npm test inline should be nudged to delegate to a throwaway subagent.

cc-npm-test-active-subagent.json.description: CC: npm test + active + subagent → allow, NO nudge
cc-npm-test-active-subagent.json.notes: Subagents should run build/test directly — no nudge.

cc-checkout-branch-active-controller.jso.description: CC: git checkout -b + active + controller → allow, NO nudge (branch creation is not a git mutate)
cc-checkout-branch-active-controller.jso.notes: git checkout -b is branch creation (read-ish setup), not a git mutate. Must NOT match isGitMutate or isCommit.

cc-git-status-active-controller.json.description: CC: git status + active + controller → allow, NO nudge (read op)
cc-git-status-active-controller.json.notes: git status is a read operation. Must not trigger N2 or any block.

cc-commit-no-markers.json.description: CC: git commit + NO active + NO gate-open → allow silently (plugin inert)
cc-commit-no-markers.json.notes: With no markers present, the guard is completely inert. Exit 0 with no JSON output.

cursor-commit-gate-open.json.description: Cursor: git commit + gate-open → deny + failClosed:true
cursor-commit-gate-open.json.notes: Cursor B1. The response must include failClosed:true in the JSON output.

cursor-npm-test-active.json.description: Cursor: npm test + active → allow (N1 nudge degrades to prose on Cursor)
cursor-npm-test-active.json.notes: Cursor has no allow-path context injection. N1/N2 nudges degrade to plain allow. The harness sets CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR and CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT.
